title: My First Python Analysis
text:
This is my first Python analysis post!


Code
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {"Month": ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr"], 
        "Value": [120, 145, 133, 160]}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.bar(df["Month"], df["Value"], color="#2563eb")
ax.set_title("My First Chart")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
